title: Cost-Efficient Privacy Enforcement for Email-Generating LLM Agents under Strategic Information Requests
abstract: arXiv:2610.18007v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents now act as delegated communication intermediaries: they read private context, draft messages, and send externally visible emails on behalf of a user. Existing checker-repair defenses can reduce inappropriate disclosure, but they rely on repeated calls to a remote action LLM (the model that drafts and repairs the email) and a remote checker LLM whenever a draft fails validation. This creates a cost problem as well as a privacy problem, especially when a requester strategically asks for exact values, raw records, source evidence, or other details that induce leakage-heavy drafts. We propose local contract-conditioned rewriting as a cost-efficient enforcement layer for email-generating agents. The mechanism intercepts an outgoing draft, constructs an information-release contract that specifies what to preserve, generalize, and forbid, rewrites the draft with a local Gemma rewriter, and selectively invokes a final PrivacyChecker

translated_title: 战略性信息请求下面向邮件生成LLM代理的低成本隐私执行机制
translated_abstract: LLM代理如今扮演着受委托的通信中介角色：它们读取私人上下文、起草消息，并代表用户发送对外可见的电子邮件。现有的检查器-修复防御机制能够减少不当信息披露，但每当草稿未通过验证时，它们都需要反复调用远程动作LLM（即起草和修复邮件的模型）和远程检查器LLM。这既带来了成本问题，也带来了隐私问题，尤其是当请求者策略性地索要精确数值、原始记录、来源证据或其他容易诱导高泄露草稿的细节时。我们提出本地基于契约条件的重写方法，作为邮件生成代理的低成本隐私执行层。该机制拦截外发草稿，构建一个信息发布契约以规定哪些内容需要保留、泛化和禁止，使用本地Gemma重写器重写草稿，并有选择地调用最终的PrivacyChecker进行核验。
tldr: 该论文提出一种本地契约条件重写机制，通过拦截邮件草稿、构建信息发布契约并用本地Gemma模型重写，为邮件生成LLM代理提供低成本的隐私执行层，避免了对远程LLM的反复高成本调用。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes local contract-conditioned rewriting as a cost-efficient privacy enforcement layer for email-generating LLM agents, intercepting drafts, constructing information-release contracts, and rewriting locally with Gemma to avoid costly repeated calls to remote LLMs.
